name: PyZX
description: PyZX is an open-source Python library for quantum circuit rewriting and optimization using the ZX-calculus, a graphical language for reasoning about quantum computations. It can read circuits in QASM, Quipper, and Quantomatic formats, apply automated simplification rules, and export optimized circuits.

sources.title: PyZX: Large Scale Automated Diagrammatic Reasoning
Graph-theoretic Simplification of Quantum Circuits with the ZX-calculus

news.title: PyZX 0.10.4 released with 'magic cat' decomposition strategy and strict phase type checking
news.excerpt: PyZX 0.10.4 introduces the magic cat decomposition strategy from arXiv:2202.09202, adds a strict_phase_types setting enabled by default to prevent float phases at set_phase/add_to_phase, and fixes a crash in full_reduce when processing non-Clifford spiders.
